verdict.rationale: Synctera's own docs show a Cards API that issues, activates, and manages cards for customers alongside its accounts, payments, and transfers APIs, so cards are issued through the same platform API as accounts. Nothing in the evidence covers the other elements of the story. missing for 10: explicit virtual vs. physical debit card issuance, documentation of card-to-account linkage, spend controls/limits, digital wallet (Apple/Google Pay) provisioning, independent or hands-on corroboration.
